name: ImageDrawArc
description: Draws a circular or elliptical arc.
syntax: ImageDrawArc( any image, number x, number y, number width, number height, number startAngle, number arcAngle, [boolean filled] )

params.name: image
params.description: The image on which this operation is performed.

params.name: x
params.description: The x coordinate of the upper-left corner of the arc.

params.name: y
params.description: The y coordinate of the upper-left corner of the arc.

params.name: arcAngle
params.description: The angular extent of the arc, relative to the start angle.

params.name: filled
params.description:
Specify whether the arc is filled:

- true: The arc is filled with the specified drawing color.
- false (default): Only the outline of the arc is drawn.
